tools.name: workflow.list
tools.description: List the implementations published to this harness and their workflows, each with its `headlessSafe` mark (whether every interactive step declares what to do without a person).

tools.name: workflow.describe
tools.description: Describe one workflow before deciding a run can complete without a person: its inputs (types, required, defaults), its outputs, the job/step graph in dependency order, and each interactive step’s `headless` declaration.

workflow.description: The workflow id — the file base name minus `.workflow.yaml`, e.g. `interactive`.

tools.name: workflow.start
tools.description: Start a run of a workflow with the given inputs. Validated exactly as the kickoff form validates a person’s values; a refusal names each bad input. Returns the run id and its first snapshot, and moves the page to the run.

inputs.description: Values for `on.manual.inputs`, keyed by input name. An omitted input takes its declared default; a `file` input is a whole File ref (`{ path, name, contentType, size, url }`), never a bare path or a URL. Pass `{}` for a workflow with no inputs.

workflow.description: The workflow id — the file base name minus `.workflow.yaml`, e.g. `interactive`.

tools.name: workflow.status
tools.description: The run snapshot: status, the steps in flight, every reached step’s status, the outputs so far, and `waitingOn` — for each waiting step what would satisfy it (its kind, its evaluated inputs, an island’s declared outputs and src).

runId.description: The run to act on. Optional where a current run exists (the harness page); required over the MCP endpoint.

tools.name: workflow.await
tools.description: Wait until the run needs input (`until: "waiting"`) or ends (`until: "terminal"`), then return its snapshot. The polite alternative to polling `workflow.status`.

runId.description: The run to act on. Optional where a current run exists (the harness page); required over the MCP endpoint.

until.description: `waiting`: resolve as soon as the run needs input (a step is `waiting`) or ends; `terminal`: resolve only when the run ends.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait before answering with the current snapshot and `timedOut: true` (default 120000).

tools.name: workflow.runs
tools.description: Past runs of one workflow, newest first: id, status, when it started and ended, and which steps it is waiting on.

impl.description: The implementation alias; defaults to the current run’s (or the page’s) on the harness page.

limit.description: At most this many runs, newest first (default 20).

workflow.description: The workflow id; defaults to the current run’s (or the page’s) on the harness page.

tools.name: workflow.submitStep
tools.description: Complete a waiting interactive step, or open it for the person. A `form` step takes a value per field; an `island` step takes its declared outputs. Validated by the same checks a person’s submit runs; a refusal names each bad value. In an agent host that renders this tool’s UI, call it with `values: {}` for an island or form step: the step’s own UI is shown and the person completes it there — do not invent values for them.

step.description: The waiting step’s key, `<job>/<index>/<step>` — as listed in the snapshot’s `waitingOn`.

runId.description: The run to act on. Optional where a current run exists (the harness page); required over the MCP endpoint.

values.description: For a `form` step: a value per field, keyed by field name (a `choice` over File refs takes the ref’s `path`). For an `island` step: the step’s declared outputs, keyed by output name.

tools.name: workflow.outputs
tools.description: The run’s outputs — File refs (`{ path, name, contentType, size, url }`), never bytes.

runId.description: The run to act on. Optional where a current run exists (the harness page); required over the MCP endpoint.

tools.name: workflow.sign
tools.description: Exchange a File ref’s `path` for a short-lived presigned GET URL (`{ url, expiresIn }`), the same one islands get to show media.

path.description: A File ref’s `path` — an uploads-relative key under `workflows/`. Nothing else is signable.

runId.description: The run to act on. Optional where a current run exists (the harness page); required over the MCP endpoint.

tools.name: workflow.cancel
tools.description: Cancel the run. Server-side pipeline jobs already enqueued keep running.

runId.description: The run to act on. Optional where a current run exists (the harness page); required over the MCP endpoint.

tools.name: workflow.resume
tools.description: Take over a `running` run whose driver went away (an expired lease) so this surface drives it from here — how an agent adopts a run another tab or host abandoned.

tools.name: workflow.submit
tools.description: Complete the waiting island step of a run with its declared outputs — the island's own `workflow.submit` (spec 04), answered server-side: validated against the step's declared output map exactly as the harness page validates it, then written to the step row. Refused while a harness tab still drives the run.

step.description: The step key, `<job>/<index>/<step>`, of the waiting island step.

runId.description: The run the island belongs to.

outputs.description: The values for the step’s declared outputs.

tools.name: workflow.annotate
tools.description: Record annotations and/or a summary on the waiting island step — the island's own `workflow.annotate` (spec 04), budgeted per step exactly as on the harness page.

step.description: The step key, `<job>/<index>/<step>`, of the waiting island step.

runId.description: The run the island belongs to.

annotations.description: Entries of `{ level: notice|warning|error, message, title? }`.

tools.name: workflow.pipeline
tools.description: Call one of the run's own implementation's pipelines on the island's behalf — a tool name resolves to `/api/<impl>/<path>` (dots as slashes) and is fenced to that implementation exactly as on the harness page (spec 04).

name.description: The pipeline’s tool name, e.g. `echo` or `video.slice`.

step.description: The step key, `<job>/<index>/<step>`, of the waiting island step.

runId.description: The run the island belongs to.

tools.name: workflow.stepView
tools.description: What the step view needs to mount a waiting interactive step. An island: its HTML (unchanged, fetched from the implementation's bundle), the step's persisted inputs (its tool-input arguments) and its declared outputs. A form: the fields the harness evaluated when the step started waiting, their initial values, the title and the submit label.

step.description: The step key, `<job>/<index>/<step>`, of the waiting island step.

runId.description: The run the island belongs to.

static.name: Workflow step view
static.description: Mounts a waiting island or form step of a run (spec 10).

templates.name: island
templates.description: An island of an implementation, served unchanged from its bundle (spec 04).

instructions: The BFFless Workflow harness: 11 workflow.* tools to list, describe and watch runs and complete a waiting interactive step (island or form). Pass runId to every run-scoped tool.
